introduction.text: Casa Museo di Luigi Pirandello, archivio e biblioteca is a museum in Rome that preserves the former apartment of the Nobel laureate Luigi Pirandello, offering insight into his life and works.

history.description: Luigi Pirandello lived in the apartment from 1933 to 1936, where he worked on his later plays.
Pirandello received news of his Nobel Prize award in 1934 while staying in the house.
In 1962 the Institute of Pirandellian Studies and Contemporary Theatre was founded, preserving the apartment as a museum.

design.description: The apartment has been preserved with original furnishings, paintings, books, and manuscripts, reflecting the living environment of Pirandello.

art.description: The museum houses paintings, books, manuscripts, and other original objects belonging to Pirandello.
